title: Convert Sorted Array to Binary Search Tree

story.title: Planting a Balanced Orchard
story.text: Sorted fruit weights are planted so the tree stays balanced: the middle weight becomes the root, and each half is planted the same way as its branch.
story.goal: Return a height-balanced BST built from the sorted array.

hints: Several balanced trees are valid on LeetCode; these tests expect the lower-middle root, mid = (lo + hi) / 2.
